name: Bellwether Rewired

acceptance.scope: Native Chromium software WebGL with normal application inputs and synthetic gamepad/XR device frames; not physical hardware certification.

publication.initialAttempt: Failed before Pages deployment finished; successful retry is the authoritative receipt.

liveBrowser.scope: Actual public HTTPS application. Synthetic downward head pose and explicit VR/AR session requests. Captures show the miniature; they do not establish physical passthrough, stereo quality or comfort.

archive.recovery: The original collector selected an older failed artifact with the same name. The repaired workflow validates the successful publication run and selects its newest receipt by creation time, verifies the full file set and hashes, and archives the original release source without altering it.
archive.scope: Public game source and evidence; no player saves, private narrative, full Git mirror or off-site backup. Older release tags were not replaced.

implemented.chapter: First Bellwether replacement slice: differentiated street/service approaches, repeatable electrical demonstrator, physical dial gauges and network feedback, circuit-unlocked service shutter, continuous multi-level maintenance ascent, gallery views back over the market, receiver and repaired return route.
implemented.presentation: Selectable first-person VR, third-person diorama VR, third-person diorama AR and desktop diorama preview of the same simulation.
implemented.character: Render-only skinned courier with calibrated height, speed-matched walk/run clips and bounded foot grounding. Authored airborne, climbing, rail and weapon poses remain future work.
implemented.input: Existing Xbox mappings and remaps, Xbox inside XR, tracked-controller gameplay, and tracked-hand spatial UI. Hands do not provide combat or locomotion.
implemented.arPlacement: Adjustable local-floor placement, scale, rotation, height and recenter; not detected furniture, room meshes or persistent room anchors.
implemented.access: Open XR / diorama views from the start screen, pause menu or settings. Select the session mode before entering XR. The desktop preview requires no headset.

continuation: The runtime and tag are released, not a pending candidate. Retain the attached September 15 design brief as the authoring basis. Next tune arrival composition, safe first-contact teaching, route recognition, rail sightlines, encounter choices and the meaningful return through unfamiliar-player and hardware playtests. Do not resume the earlier transfer scaffolding or merge the separate living-city experiment. This receipt is outside the runtime manifest so recording verification does not create a new same-version game release.
